decisions.reason: As an adjustable cardboard quarter-pallet display, it fits the firm's core offer very closely and supports its service-led, problem-solving positioning.
The pegboard-back cardboard display is a core in-store display variant that broadens customer choice without moving away from the firm's established manufacturing strengths.
Although it overlaps with other cardboard quarter-pallet formats, it remains close to the firm's narrow but focused display portfolio and is still worth keeping in market.
The eighth-pallet format extends the firm's standard cardboard display range and is consistent with its aim to serve different retail footprints.
The wooden display pallet is somewhat less central than the cardboard products, but it still builds on the firm's POS display business and can strengthen its one-stop offer.
This media-oriented cardboard quarter-pallet display is slightly more niche, yet it remains well aligned with the firm's established display capabilities and customer base.
